title: driver-sql: presentReadValue has no boolean kind, so distinct and aggregates over a boolean column show raw 1/0 (or legacy 'true'/'false') on SQLite
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3: a follow-up of p1 #34916 (PR #34965), ruled out of that PR's scope (seat ruling 6957305509; L1-d 6959775843). It is pre-existing, and #34965 does not widen it.

## What happens

`presentReadValue` in driver-sql maps read values by field kind, but has no boolean kind. `distinct` and aggregate results over a boolean column therefore come back as raw `1` / `0` (and legacy `'true'` / `'false'`) on SQLite, where record reads show booleans.

A group-by or distinct over a yes/no field shows 1/0 buckets.

## Done when

- A boolean kind in `presentReadValue` covers distinct and aggregate outputs.
- A pin on SQLite: distinct over a boolean column returns `true` / `false`.

Grade: **p3 · domain:server** (out of focus). It is a visible but cosmetic bucket label on one driver. Alone that would be p2, so one grade lower out of focus gives p3.
